paragraphs: From Clonmel Test Centre depart onto the R707 and take the 1st right onto Ballingarrane.
Take the next right to stay on Ballingarrane.
At the roundabout take the exit to the left towards Marlfield.
At the next roundabout take the left onto Western Road and continue straight for just over 1km.
Turn right onto Cantwell Street.
At the end of the road turn left onto Irishtown Upper.
Continue straight as the road becomes O'Connell Street.
Turn left onto Gladstone Street.
Take the next right onto Market Street.
Turn right again onto Emmet Street to reach Parnell Street.
Continue straight as Parnell Street becomes The Mall and then Davis Road.
Go straight through the roundabout staying on Davis Road.
At the next roundabout take the exit to the left, still on Davis Road.
At the rotary take the slight left onto Frank Drohan Road and continue straight for roughly 1.7km.
At the next rotary take the slight left onto Tivoli Road and exit left.
Turn right onto Slievenamon Road.
Turn right into the unnamed side road and stop for a practice manoeuvre.
Depart and perform a U-turn.
At the end of the road turn right back onto Slievenamon Road.
Take the next left to continue on Slievenamon Road.
At the end of the road turn right onto Clonmel East Urban.
Take a slight right onto Ard Na Gréine.
Depart Ard Na Gréine, take a sharp right and then a left to stay on the estate road.
Turn left onto Slievenamon Road.
Continue straight as the road becomes King Street, then Kickham Street, then Kickham Park.
At the end of the road turn left onto Upper Gladstone Street.
Turn right onto Queen Street to rejoin Western Road.
Follow Western Road to the roundabout and take the exit to the left onto Cahir Road for about 575m.
At the next roundabout take the right towards Marlfield.
At the end of the road turn left onto Ballingarrane.
Take the next left, then left again onto the R707.
Take the final right via Glenconner Road to arrive back at Clonmel Test Centre.
